parameters.query:
WITH client_filter AS (
  SELECT $1::INT AS cid, $2::VARCHAR AS user_role
),
filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.*, p.name AS product_name
  FROM shreeji_app.orders o
  JOIN shreeji_app.products p ON o.product_id = p.id
  CROSS JOIN client_filter cf
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (cf.user_role = 'ADMIN' OR o.client_id = cf.cid)
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::INT AS total_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('Delivered', 'Cancelled') THEN 1 END)::INT AS pending_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN order_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END)::INT AS today_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Delivered' THEN 1 END)::INT AS delivered_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END)::INT AS cancelled_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(total_lots), 0)::INT AS total_lots,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Production Planned' THEN 1 END)::INT AS production_planned,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Dispatched' THEN 1 END)::INT AS dispatched_orders
  FROM filtered_orders
),
product_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    product_name,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS order_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS total_qty
  FROM filtered_orders
  GROUP BY product_name
  ORDER BY order_count DESC
),
status_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS count
  FROM filtered_orders
  GROUP BY status
),
recent_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    order_date,
    submission_timestamp,
    product_name,
    destination,
    total_lots,
    total_quantity,
    status
  FROM filtered_orders
  ORDER BY submission_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 8
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT row_to_json(c) FROM counts c) AS metrics,
  (SELECT json_agg(p) FROM product_summary p) AS products,
  (SELECT json_agg(s) FROM status_summary s) AS statuses,
  (SELECT json_agg(r) FROM recent_orders r) AS recent;
